title: Bandcamp Wishlist-to-Purchase Ratio
dataSources: Release events (`music:distribution`), Bandcamp activity (`music:bandcamp`), project exports (`music:project`), streaming analytics (`music:streaming`), metadata tasks (`music:ops`).
app: Music-making and creator telemetry — DistroKid release exports, Bandcamp sales activity, Cockos Reaper project stats, and Spotify for Artists analytics — streamed to Splunk HEC via APIs, exports, and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=music:bandcamp release_name=* purchased_after_wishlist=*
| stats count as total, sum(eval(if(purchased_after_wishlist="yes",1,0))) as matched by release_name
| eval a_wishlist_conversion_pct=round(100*matched/total,1)
| sort - a_wishlist_conversion_pct
description: Measures the percentage of wishlist events that end with a wishlist conversion by release.
value: Completion and exception percentages make it easier to spot which release are helping or hurting wishlist events.
implementation: Store a normalized flag for `a wishlist conversion` on `music:bandcamp` events and summarize the hit rate by `release_name`.
visualization: Table of release with percentage of wishlist events ending with a wishlist conversion.
grandmaExplanation: It flags how often a wishlist conversion happens for each release so you can see where wishlist events go smoothly or get stuck.
